SELECT  
								n_id,
								c_port_code,
								d_report_date,
								c_element_code,
								n_order,
								c_report_template,
								c_user,
								c_update_time,
								c_parent_code,
								n_type,
								n_state,
								c_value,
								c_context,
								c_xbrl_element_code,
								c_query_id,
								c_value_long,
								x_order,
								c_sql_id,
								c_element_attr,
								c_period,
								c_report_type,
								c_remark,
								c_chapter_id,
								c_edit_state,
								c_port_class,
								c_report_id,
								c_index_arrt,
								c_validate_state,
								bath_dt,
								data_ins_time,
								task_rs_id
							FROM ${srcdbname}.fa45bbzx_t_xbrl_report_adjust WHERE 
							year(d_report_date) between  
year(cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(cast(${end_date} as string),'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') as date)  - interval 1 YEAR) and 
year(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(cast(${end_date} as string),'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd'))

preSql:
delete from fa45bbzx_t_xbrl_report_adjust t where 
						to_char(d_report_date,'yyyy')  between 
						to_char(to_date(CAST(${end_date} AS varchar2(10)),'yyyyMMdd')-365,'yyyy') and 
						to_char(to_date(CAST(${end_date} AS varchar2(10)),'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy')
